summary: Prevent wrapped fixed-height button labels, under-padded summary cells, and nested-pane overflow, and require composed Storybook stories to expose complete copyable source.
contractImpact: Button preserves existing APIs and interaction behavior while guaranteeing a single-line visible label within its fixed control height. Consumer compositions reflow against their split or resizable pane width. Rendered audits add diagnostics for control-label overflow, bordered summary cells without minimum inline insets, and nested responsive regions wider than their pane. Storybook composition stories retain their rendered output while exposing generated full implementation source.
